_note: Repeat groups arise because 260 families share 78 prompts; each group is independent calls at identical settings, so it measures runtime variance.
_LIMITATION_within_run_only: These 49 groups are repeats WITHIN a single generation pass. The v1 floor was measured ACROSS separate runs (r0/r1/r2). They are not directly comparable: within-run repeats share session and batching conditions, and the v1 evidence showed variance is bimodal with mode selection plausibly tied to batching. A within-run floor can therefore understate across-run variance.
_across_run_v2_evidence: Superseded by across_run below, which measures the full expanded set instead of the 3 volatile families. Retained for history: prose:cekAman::0001 and prose:tanyaDokumen::0001 were stable across 3 runs; prose:umum::0000 showed 2 modes.

across_run._traces_are_gitignored: Both files are excluded by .gitignore (*.jsonl). The digests above, plus data/<pass>/MANIFEST.json, are the committed record of which bytes this measurement read. Regenerating a pass produces different bytes and a different digest — that invalidates this result rather than reproducing it.
across_run._plan_consistency: All 9 pinned fields identical across passes (split_fingerprint ccb5ff683228c4c9, template_sha256 114f55eb…, muse-glimmer:30b, int4_ollama, ai19-ollama, reasoning high, temperature 0.0, seed 0). The two passes are two observations of one configuration.

_metric_coverage_unique_prompt.source_preserved: 0/78 — NO COVERAGE, no prompt carries a preserve list

across_run._finding: The across-run METRIC floor is 0.0, same as the within-run floor — so the within-run measurement did not understate the metric floor after all. But answer TEXT is not equally stable: 2 of 78 prompts (2.6%) produced a mode in one pass that was absent from the other. Textual variance across runs is real and non-zero; it simply did not move any metric.

_mode_shift_groups.shape: 1 mode in A, 2 in B — B added a variant that answers the question in the negative ('the memo does not state implementation provisions')
2 modes in A, 1 in B — the mode missing from B preserved the source figures (346 bit, 5 jam) correctly; both modes are plausible edits

across_run._LIMITATION_coverage: This 0.0 floor is not a statement about the whole corpus. constraints_ok and router_correct are decidable only on the 8 router strata (closed_set is the only check kind in use anywhere); the 18 document/edit/prose strata carry no checks and no expected label, so they contribute to the answer-agreement counts but to no metric mean. Both mode-shift groups fall in unchecked strata — which is where a shift would be invisible to the metrics by construction. Read the 0.0 as: no metric moved among the metrics that can move.
across_run._use: ROUTER-STRATA FLOOR ONLY. Usable as the across-run floor for the 8 router strata. Two prohibitions, standing until the non-router strata carry checks and this comparison is re-run: (1) do NOT cite this 0.0 as evidence of corpus-wide reproducibility — 18 of 26 strata contributed to no metric in it; (2) do NOT promote this corpus to training. A pass whose 18 unchecked strata were never mechanically verified is not cleared for training merely because the checked 8 held steady.
